question: Where will the 17th Edition of BioFach India be held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Greater Noida.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 17th Edition of BioFach India will be held at the India Expo Centre and Mart in Greater Noida.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 17th Edition of BioFach India will take place at the India Expo Centre and Mart in Greater Noida.**
 
• **Over 27 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) from the North-Eastern Region will showcase products under the Mission Organic Value Chain Development.**
 
• **The event will bring together organic producers, buyers, businesses, policymakers, and stakeholders globally.**
 
• **The event aims to increase the visibility of North-Eastern organic products and build partnerships for the region's agricultural ecosystem.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• BioFach India__

 __
 
• Is an event dedicated to organic products, bringing together global stakeholders in the organic sector.
 
 
 
• Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)__
 __
 
• Organizations of farmers that collectively market their products and promote their welfare.
 
 
 
• Mission Organic Value Chain Development__
 
 
• A program aimed at promoting organic farming and connecting farmers to global markets.
